Pea ne ngaohi ʻae meʻa fakapulonga ki he fale fehikitaki ʻaki ʻae ngaahi kili ʻoe sipitangata tukukula, mo e meʻa fakapulonga ʻe taha ʻi ʻolunga ʻi ai, ko e kili ʻoe pasia.
And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.
Pea ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi laupapa ki he fale fehikitaki ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi ke tuʻu tonu.
And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
Ko hono lōloa ʻoe laupapa ʻe taha ko e hanga ʻe uofulu, mo hono lau lahi ʻoe laupapa ʻe taha ko e hanga ʻe tolu.
The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
Naʻe ua hono mui ki he laupapa ʻe taha, pea tatau pe hono mamaʻo ʻoe taha ki he taha: pea naʻa ne fai pehē pe ki he ngaahi laupapa kotoa pē ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi laupapa ki he fale fehikitaki; ko e laupapa ʻe uofulu ki he faʻahi ki tonga ke hanga ki tonga;
And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

Pea ne ngaohi ʻae tuʻunga siliva ʻe fāngofulu ʻi lalo ʻi he laupapa ʻe uofulu; ko e tuʻunga ʻe ua ʻi lalo ʻi he laupapa ʻe taha ki hono mui ʻe ua, mo e tuʻunga ʻe ua ʻi lalo he laupapa ʻe taha ki hono mui ʻe ua.
And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
Pea ko hono faʻahi ʻe taha ʻoe fale fehikitaki, ʻaia ʻoku hanga ki he tuliki fakatokelau, naʻa ne ngaohi ki ai ʻae laupapa ʻe uofulu,
And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
Mo honau tuʻunga siliva ʻe fāngofulu ko e tuʻunga ʻe ua ʻi lalo ʻi he laupapa ʻe taha, mo e tuʻunga ʻe ua ʻi lalo ʻi he laupapa ʻe taha.
And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Pea ne ngaohi ʻae laupapa ʻe ono ki he potu lulunga ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
Pea ne ngaohi ʻae laupapa ʻe ua ki he tuliki ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻi hono faʻahi ʻe ua.
And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
Pea naʻe fakamaʻu ia ki lalo, pea fakamaʻu ke fakataha ia ʻi he ʻulu ʻo ia, ki he kavei pe taha: pea fai pehē pe ʻe ia ki ai ʻi he tuliki ʻe ua.
And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
Pea naʻe ʻi ai ʻae laupapa ʻe valu; pea ko honau tuʻunga ko e tuʻunga siliva ʻe hongofulu ma ono, naʻe ua ʻae tuʻunga ʻi lalo ʻoe laupapa kotoa pē.
And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau fakamaʻu ʻoe sitimi; ko e nima ki he ngaahi laupapa ʻi he faʻahi ʻe taha ʻoe fale fehikitaki,
And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Mo e ʻakau fakamaʻu ʻe nima ki ha ngaahi laupapa ʻoe faʻahi ʻe taha ʻoe fale fehikitaki, pea mo e ʻakau fakamaʻu ʻe nima ki he ngaahi laupapa ʻi he potu lulunga ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ʻakau fakamaʻu ʻi loto ke velo ʻi he laupapa kotoa pē mei he potu ʻe taha ʻo aʻu atu ki he potu ʻe taha.
And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
Pea naʻa ne ʻaofi ʻaki ʻae koula ʻae ngaahi laupapa kotoa pē, ʻo ngaohi honau ngaahi kavei ko e koula, ke velo ai ʻae ʻakau fakamaʻu, pea ne ʻaofi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau fakamaʻu ʻaki ʻae koula.
And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae puipui ʻaki ʻae lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale: pea naʻe ʻai ki ai ʻae ngaahi selupimi ʻi he ngāue fakapotopoto.
And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ki ai ʻae pou ʻe fā ʻoe ʻakau ko e sitimi, ʻo ne ʻaofi ia ʻaki ʻae koula: ko e koula hono tautauʻanga; pea naʻa ne haka ki ai ʻae tuʻunga siliva ʻe fā.
And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae meʻa tautau ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻaki ʻae lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale, ʻoe ngāue tuitui;
And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
Mo hono pou ʻe nima ʻo ia, mo e ngaahi tautauʻanga: pea naʻa ne ʻaofi honau ʻuluʻi pou, mo honau ngaahi tākai ʻaki ʻae koula: ka ko honau tuʻunga ʻe nima ko e palasa ia.
And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
Pea naʻe ngaohi ʻe Pesalili ʻae puha ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi: ko e hanga ʻe nima hono lōloa, mo e hanga ʻe tolu hono māukupu, mo e hanga ʻe tolu ʻa hono māʻolunga:
And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
Pea naʻa ne ʻaofi ʻaki ia ʻae koula haohaoa ʻi loto mo tuʻa, ʻo ne ngaohi ʻae tatā koula ki ai ke takatakai ia.
And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
Pea naʻa ne haka ʻae kavei koula ʻe fā ki ai, ke ʻai ʻo ofi ki hono tuliki ʻe fā: ʻio, ʻae kavei ʻe ua ʻi hono faʻahi ʻe taha, mo e kavei ʻe ua ki hono faʻahi ʻe taha.
And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ʻakau ʻe ua ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi, ʻo ne ʻaofi ʻaki ia ʻae koula.
And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Pea ne ʻai ʻae ongo ʻakau ki he kavei ʻi he ongo faʻahi ʻoe puha, ke haʻamo ʻaki.
And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa ʻaki ʻae koula haohaoa: ko e hanga ʻe nima ʻa hono lōloa, mo e hanga ʻe tolu ʻa hono māukupu ʻo ia.
And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ongo selupimi koula, ʻo ne tuki ʻakinaua mei he konga koula pe taha, ʻi hono potu ʻe ua ʻoe nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa.
And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
Ko e selupi ʻe taha ʻi he potu ʻi he faʻahi ni, mo e selupi ʻe taha ʻi hono potu ʻe taha ʻi he faʻahi ʻe taha: naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ongo selupimi ʻi he nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa: ʻi hono potu ʻe ua ʻo ia.
One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

Pea naʻe mafola hake ki ʻolunga hona kapakau ʻe he ongo selupimi, ʻo na maluʻi ʻaki hona kapakau ʻae nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa, pea naʻe fehāngaaki hona mata; ʻio, naʻe hanga ki he nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa ʻae mata ʻoe ongo selupimi.
And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae palepale ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi: ko e hanga ʻe fā ʻa hono lōloa, mo e hanga ʻe ua hono māukupu ʻo ia, mo e hanga ʻe tolu ʻa hono māʻolunga:
And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
Pea ne ʻaofi ʻaki ia ʻae koula haohaoa, ʻo ne ngaohi ʻae tatā koula ke takatakai ia.
And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi foki ki ai ʻae tapa ke takatakai ia ko e nima ʻe taha hono laulahi: ʻo ne ngaohi ʻae tatā koula ki he tapa ʻo ia ke takatakai.
Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
Pea ne haka ʻae kavei koula ʻe fā ki ai, ʻo ai ʻae kavei ki hono tuliki ʻe fā ʻaia naʻe ʻi hono vaʻe ʻe fā.
And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
Naʻe tuku tonu ki he tapa ʻae ngaahi kavei, ko e ʻaiʻanga ʻoe ongo ʻakau ke haʻamo ʻaki ʻae palepale.
Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
Pea ne ngaohi ʻae ongo ʻakau ʻaki ʻae sitimi, pea naʻe ʻaofi ʻaki ia ʻae koula, ke haʻamo ʻaki ʻae palepale.
And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi ipu ʻi he palepale, ʻae ngaahi ipu kai, mo e ngaahi ohu, mo hono ngaahi ipu luoluo, mo e ngaahi meʻa ʻufiʻufi, ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki, ʻaki ʻae koula haohaoa.
And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae tuʻunga maama ʻaki ʻae koula haohaoa: ʻo ne ngaohi ʻae tuʻunga maama ʻaki ʻae ngāue tuki: ʻa hono kau, mo hono pasanga, mo hono ngaahi ipu siʻi, mo hono ngaahi teunga potopoto, mo hono ngaahi fisi, naʻe ʻi he meʻa pe ko ia.
And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
Mo e pasanga ʻe ono naʻe tuʻu ʻi hono potu ʻe ua: ko e pasanga ʻe tolu ʻoe tuʻunga maama mei hono potu ʻe taha, mo e pasanga ʻe tolu ʻoe tuʻunga maama mei hono potu ʻe taha:
And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

Ko e ipu siʻi ʻe tolu ʻi he pasanga ʻe taha kuo ngaohi ʻo hangē ko e fuaʻitelie, ko e teunga potopoto mo e fisi; pea ko e ipu siʻi ʻe tolu kuo ngaohi ʻo hangē ko e fuaʻitelie ʻi he pasanga ʻe taha, ko e teunga potopoto mo e fisi; pea ke pehē pe ʻi he pasanga ʻe ono ʻoku tuʻu ʻi he tuʻunga maama.

Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
Pea naʻe ʻi he tuʻunga maama ʻae ipu siʻi ʻe fā kuo ngaohi ʻo hangē ko e fuaʻitelie, ko hono ngaahi teunga potopoto mo hono ngaahi fisi:
And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

Ko e teunga potopoto ʻe taha ʻi lalo ʻoe pasanga ʻe ua, mo e teunga potopoto ʻe taha ʻi lalo ʻi he pasanga ʻe ua, mo e teunga potopoto ʻe taha ʻi lalo ʻi he pasanga ʻe ua, ʻo fakatatau ki he pasanga ʻe ono ʻoku tuʻu ʻi ai.
And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
Ko honau ngaahi teunga potopoto mo honau ngaahi pasanga naʻe ʻi he meʻa pe ko ia: ko e konga koula tuki pe taha ʻaia kotoa pē.
Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi hono foʻi maama ʻe fitu, mo hono ngaahi helekosi-maama, mo hono ʻaiʻanga helekosi, ʻaki ʻae koula haohaoa.
And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
Ko e taleniti koula pe taha naʻa ne ngaohi ʻaki ia, mo hono ngaahi ipu kotoa pē.
Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae feilaulauʻanga meʻa namu kakala ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi: ko hono lōloa ko e hanga ʻe ua, mo hono māukupu ko e hanga ʻe ua; naʻe potupotu tatau pe: pea ko e hanga ʻe fā ʻa hono māʻolunga; pea ko hono ngaahi nifo naʻe ʻi he meʻa pe ko ia.
And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
Pea naʻa ne ʻaofi ʻaki ia ʻae koula haohaoa, ʻi hono funga ʻo ia, mo hono ngaahi potu ʻo takatakai, mo hono ngaahi nifo: pea naʻa ne ngaohi foki ki ai ʻae tatā koula ke takatakai.
And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi hono kavei koula ʻe ua ʻi lalo ʻi he tatā ʻo ia, ʻo ofi ki hono tuliki ʻe ua, ki hono potu ʻe ua, ke velo ai ʻae ongo ʻakau ke haʻamo ʻaki.
And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ongo haʻamo ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi, pea naʻe ʻaofi ia ʻaki ʻae koula.
And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae lolo tākai tapu, mo e meʻa namu lelei, ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻakau nanamu, ʻo taau mo e ngāue ʻae tangata fua vai.
And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae feilaulauʻanga ʻoe feilaulau tutu, ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi: ko e hanga ʻe hongofulu ʻa hono lōloa, mo e hanga ʻe hongofulu ʻa hono māukupu; naʻe potupotu tatau ia; pea ko e hanga ʻe ono ʻa hono māʻolunga.
And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi hono ngaahi nifo ʻo ia, ʻi hono tuliki ʻe fā; ko hono ngaahi nifo, naʻe ʻi he meʻa ko ia pea naʻa ne ʻaofi ʻaki ia ʻae palasa.
And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae nāunau kotoa pē ʻoe feilaulauʻanga, ʻae ngaahi ipu, mo e ngaahi huo, mo e ngaahi ipu luoluo, mo e ngaahi huhu ʻoe kakano, mo e ngaahi ʻaiʻanga afi; ko hono ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē naʻe ngaohi ʻaki ʻae palasa.
And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ki he feilaulauʻanga ʻae meʻa vangavanga palasa ʻi lalo ʻi hono ngataʻanga ki lalo, ʻo aʻu hifo ki hono lotolotonga ʻo ia.
And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
Pea ne haka ʻae kavei ʻe fā ki he tuliki ʻe fā ʻoe meʻa vangavanga palasa ke ʻai ki ai ʻae ongo haʻamo.
And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ongo haʻamo ʻaki ʻae ʻakau ko e sitimi, pea ʻaofi ia ʻaki ʻae palasa.
And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
Pea naʻa ne ʻai ʻae ongo ʻakau ki he kavei ʻi he potu ʻe ua ʻoe feilaulauʻanga, ke haʻamo ʻaki ia: naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae feilaulauʻanga ʻaki ʻae laupapa ke luoluo, ʻi loto.
And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae sene ʻaki ʻae palasa, mo hono tuʻunga ʻo ia ʻaki ʻae palasa, ʻoe ngaahi sioʻata ʻae kau fefine naʻe kātoa fakafaʻahinga ʻi he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi hono lotoʻā: pea ko e puipui tautau ki he potu tonga ʻo hanga ki tonga ko e tupenu tuʻovalevale, ko e hanga ʻe uangeau:
And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
Naʻe uofulu honau pou, pea uofulu mo honau tuʻunga palasa: ko e ngaahi tautauʻanga ʻoe ngaahi pou mo honau ngaahi tākai ko e siliva:
Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

Pea ko e puipui tautau ki he potu tokelau, ko e hanga ʻe uangeau, naʻe uofulu honau ngaahi pou, pea uofulu mo honau tuʻunga palasa; ko e ngaahi tautauʻanga ʻoe ngaahi pou mo honau ngaahi tākai ko e siliva.
And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
Pea ko e puipui tautau ki he potu lulunga ko e hanga ʻe teau, pea hongofulu honau pou, pea hongofulu mo honau tuʻunga: ko e ngaahi tautauʻanga ʻoe pou mo honau tākai ko e siliva.
And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
Pea ko e puipui ʻoe potu ki he hopoʻangalaʻā ko e hanga ʻe teau.
And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
Ko e meʻa tautau ki he potu ʻe taha ʻoe matapā ko e hanga ʻe tolungofulu; pea tolu honau pou, pea tolu mo honau tuʻunga.
The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Pea ki hono potu ʻe taha ʻoe matapā ʻoe lotoʻā, ʻi he nima ni, mo e nima na, naʻe ʻi ai ʻae meʻa tautau ko e hanga ʻe tolungofulu: pea tolu honau pou, pea tolu mo honau tuʻunga.
And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Ko e ngaahi puipui tautau kotoa pē ʻo takatakai ʻi he lotoʻā naʻe ngaohi ʻaki ʻae tupenu tuʻovalevale.
All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

Pea ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ki he ngaahi pou ko e palasa ia: ko e ngaahi tautauʻanga, ʻoe ngaahi pou mo honau ngaahi tākai ko e siliva ia: pea naʻe ʻaofi ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻuluʻi pou ʻae siliva: pea tākai ʻaki ʻae siliva ʻae ngaahi pou kotoa pē ʻoe lotoʻā.

And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

Pea ko e puipui tautau ki he matapā ʻoe lotoʻā ko e ngāue ʻae tuitui, ko e lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale: pea ko e hanga ʻe fāngofulu hono lōloa, pea ko hono māʻolunga fakamāukupu, ko e hanga ʻe hongofulu, ʻo fakatatau ki he ngaahi puipui tautau ʻoe lotoʻā.

And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
Pea naʻe fā honau pou, pea fā honau tuʻunga palasa: ko e siliva honau ngaahi tautauʻanga, pea ko e ʻaofi ʻo honau ngaahi ʻuluʻi pou, mo honau ngaahi tākai, ko e siliva.
And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
Pea ko e ngaahi faʻo kotoa pē ʻoe fale fehikitaki, mo e lotoʻā takatakai, ko e palasa ia.
And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

Ko eni hono lau ʻoe meʻa ʻoe fale fehikitaki, ʻio, ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fuakava, ʻo hangē ko ia naʻe lau, ʻo fakatatau ki he fekau ʻa Mōsese, ki he ngāue ʻae kau Livai, ʻi he nima ʻo ʻItama, ko e foha ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki.

This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
Pea ko Pesalili ko e foha ʻo Uli ko e foha ʻo Hua, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Siuta, naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae meʻa kotoa pē naʻe fekau ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese.
And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

Pea naʻe ʻiate ia ʻa ʻAholiapi, ko e foha ʻo ʻEhisamaki, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Tani, ko e tufunga tātā, ko e tangata ngāue fakapotopoto, pea poto ke fai teunga ʻi he lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale.
And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

Ko e koula kotoa pē naʻe fakakau ki he ngāue ʻi he ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē ʻoe potu māʻoniʻoni, ʻio, ʻae koula naʻe ʻatu, ko e taleniti ʻe uofulu ma hiva, mo e sikeli ʻe fitungeau, mā tolungofulu, ʻo fakatatau ki he sikeli ʻoe fale tapu.

All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
Pea ko e siliva ʻokinautolu naʻe lau ʻi he kakai fakataha, ko e taleniti ʻe teau, mo e sikeli ʻe taha afe ma fitungeau, mā fitungofulu ma nima, ʻo fakatatau ki he sikeli ʻoe fale tapu:
And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

Ko e pika ʻe taha ki he tangata kotoa pē, ʻaia ko e vaeuaʻanga ʻoe sikeli, ʻo fakatatau ki he sikeli ʻoe fale tapu, kiate kinautolu taki taha naʻe ʻalu ke lau, naʻe uofulu taʻu ʻene motuʻa, ʻo fai hake, ʻae kau tangata ʻe toko ono kilu mo e toko tolu afe, mo e toko nimangeau, mo e toko nimangofulu.

A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

Pea naʻe haka ʻaki ʻae taleniti siliva ʻe teau, ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga pou ʻoe fale tapu, pea mo e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoe meʻa puipui; ko e tuʻunga ʻe teau ʻi he taleniti ʻe teau, ko e taleniti ʻe taha ki he tuʻunga ʻe taha.
And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
Pea ko e sikeli ʻe taha afe ma fitungeau ma fitungofulu ma nima, naʻa ne ngaohi ʻaki ʻae ngaahi tautauʻanga ki he ngaahi pou, ʻo ne ʻaofi ʻae ngaahi ʻuluʻi pou, ʻo tākai ʻaki ia.
And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
Pea ko e palasa ʻoe ngaahi meʻaʻofa ko e taleniti ʻe fitungofulu, mo e sikeli ʻe ua afe ma fāngeau.
And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻaki ia ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, mo e feilaulauʻanga palasa mo e meʻa vangavanga palasa ki ai, mo hono ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē ʻoe feilaulauʻanga,
And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
Pea mo e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoe lotoʻā takatakai, mo e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoe matapā ʻoe lotoʻā, mo e ngaahi faʻo kotoa pē ʻoe fale fehikitaki, mo e ngaahi faʻo kotoa pē ʻoe lotoʻā ʻo ʻosi takatakai.
And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻaki ʻae lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, ʻae ngaahi kofu ngāue, ke fai ʻaki ʻae ngāue ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni, pea naʻe ngaohi ʻae ngaahi kofu tapu kia ʻElone; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae ʻefoti ʻaki ʻae koula, mo e lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale.
And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Pea naʻa nau tuki ʻae koula ke manifinifi, pea hele ia ke tuʻoiiki, koeʻuhi ke nau lalanga ia ʻi he lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale, mo e ngāue fakapotopoto.
And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
Naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae tuinga nima ʻe ua ki he uma, ke fakamaʻu fakataha ia; pea naʻe fakataha ia ʻi hono kapa ʻe ua.
They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

Pea naʻe ʻi he meʻa pe ko ia hono noʻo fakanikonikoʻi ʻoe ʻefoti naʻe ʻi ai, ʻo fakatatau ki he ngāue ʻo ia: ko e koula, mo e lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale: ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa nau tā ʻae ngaahi maka ʻoniki, pea fakamaʻu ʻi he takafi koula; kuo tongi ʻo hangē ko e tongi ʻoe mama, ʻaki ʻae ngaahi hingoa ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
Pea naʻa ne ʻai ia ki he uma ʻe ua ʻoe ʻefoti, koeʻuhi ke hoko ia ko e ngaahi maka fakamanatu ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli: ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae sīfafatafata ʻoe ngāue fakapotopoto, ʻo hangē ko e ngāue ʻoe ʻefoti; ʻi he koula, mo e lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale.
And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Naʻe potupotu tatau pe ia naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae sīfafatafata ke lōua: ko e hanga pe taha hono lōloa ʻo ia, mo e hanga pe taha hono māukupu, ʻoka peluua ia.
It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
Pea naʻa nau fakamaʻu ʻi ai ʻae ʻotu maka ʻe fā: ko hono ʻuluaki ʻotu ko e satisi, mo e topasi, mo e kapukeli: ko ʻeni ʻae ʻuluaki ʻotu.
And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
Pea ko hono ua ʻoe ʻotu, ko e ʻemalata, mo e safaia, mo e taiamoni.
And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
Pea ko hono tolu ʻoe ʻotu, ko e likua, mo e ʻaketi, mo e ʻametisi.
And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
Pea ko hono fā ʻoe ʻotu, ko e pelili, mo e ʻoniki, mo e sasipa: naʻe fakamaʻu ia ʻi he ngaahi takafi koula mo honau fakamaʻu.
And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
Pea naʻe hongofulu ma ua ʻae maka, ʻo fakatatau ki he hingoa ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo hangē ko e tohi tongitongi ʻoe mama, taki taha mo hono hingoa, ʻo fakatatau ki he faʻahinga ʻe hongofulu ma ua.
And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ki hono potu ʻe ua ʻoe sīfafatafata ʻae nonoʻo koula haohaoa ʻe ua, ko e ngāue fihifihi.
And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae takafi koula ʻe ua, mo e kavei koula ʻe ua; pea ʻai ʻae kavei ʻe ua ki hono potu ʻe ua ʻoe sīfafatafata.
And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
Pea naʻa nau ʻai ʻae ongo nonoʻo koula fihifihi ki he kavei ʻe ua ʻi hono potu ʻe ua ʻoe sīfafatafata.
And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
Pea ko hono potu ʻe ua ʻoe nonoʻo fihifihi ʻe ua, naʻa nau fakamaʻu ki he takafi ʻe ua, pea naʻe ʻai ia ki he potu ʻe ua ʻoe uma ʻoe ʻefoti ki ʻao.
And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae kavei koula ʻe ua, ʻo ʻai ia ʻi he potu ʻe ua ʻoe sīfafatafata, ki he kapa ʻo ia, ʻaia naʻe ʻi he potu ki loto ʻoe ʻefoti.
And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae kavei koula kehe ʻe ua, pea naʻe ʻai ia ʻi he potu ʻe ua ʻoe ʻefoti ʻi lalo, ʻo ofi ki he potu ki ʻao; ʻo hangatonu atu ki he fakamaʻu ʻe taha ʻo ia, ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he noʻo fakanikonikoʻi ʻoe ʻefoti.
And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

Pea naʻa nau fakamaʻu ʻae sīfafatafata ʻaki hono kavei ki he kavei ʻoe ʻefoti ʻaki ʻae noʻo lanumoana, koeʻuhi ke ʻi ʻolunga ia ʻi he noʻo fakanikonikoʻi ʻoe ʻefoti, pea koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa vete ʻae sīfafatafata mei he ʻefoti; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.

And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae kofu fakatōtōlofa ʻoe ʻefoti ʻaki ʻae ngāue lalanga, pea ko e lanumoana pe ia kātoa.
And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
Pea naʻe ai ʻae ava ʻi he loto ʻoe kofu tōtōlofa, ʻo hangē ko e ava ʻoe kofu tau, mo e meʻa fakamaʻu naʻe takatakai ʻae ava telia naʻa mahae ia.
And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻi he tapatapa ʻoe kofu fakatōtōlofa ʻae ngaahi pomikanite ʻoe lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e tupenu tuʻovalevale.
And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae ngaahi fafangu ʻoe koula haohaoa pea naʻe ai ʻae ngaahi fafangu ki he vahaʻa ʻoe pomikanite ʻi he tapa ʻoe kofu fakatōtōlofa, ʻo takatakai ʻi he vahaʻa ʻoe ngaahi pomikanite;
And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
Ko e fafangu mo e pomikanite, ko e fafangu mo e pomikanite, ʻo takatakai ʻi he tapatapa ʻoe kofu fakatōtōlofa ke fai ai ʻae ngāue: hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae ngaahi kofutuʻa ʻoe tupenu tuʻovalevale kuo lalanga moʻo ʻElone, mo hono ngaahi foha,
And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
Mo e tatā ʻoe tupenu tuʻovalevale, mo e ngaahi tatā lelei ʻoe tupenu tuʻovalevale, mo e kofu vaʻe tupenu ko e tupenu tuʻovalevale,
And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
Mo e noʻo ʻoe tupenu tuʻovalevale, mo e lanumoana, mo e paʻuhiʻuhi, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, naʻe tuitui: ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae pale ʻoe tatā tapu ʻoe koula haohaoa, ʻo tohi ki ai ʻae tohi, ʻo hangē ko e tohi tongitongi ʻoe mama, KO E MĀʻONIʻONI KIA SIHOVA.
And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
Pea naʻa nau nonoʻo ki ai ʻae noʻo ko e lanumoana, ke fakamaʻu ʻaki ia ʻi ʻolunga ki he tatā; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

Pea naʻe pehē hono fakaʻosi ʻoe ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē ki he fale tapu ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai: pea naʻe fai ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻo fakatatau ki he meʻa kotoa pē naʻe fekau ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese, naʻe pehē pe ʻenau fai.
Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

Pea naʻa nau ʻomi ʻae fale tapu kia Mōsese, ko e fale fehikitaki, mo hono nāunau kotoa pē, ko hono ngaahi fakamaʻu, mo hono ngaahi laupapa, mo hono ngaahi ʻakau fakamaʻu, mo hono ngaahi pou, mo hono ngaahi tuʻunga,
And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
Mo hono fakapulonga ʻoe kiliʻi sipitangata naʻe tukukula, pea mo e fakapulonga ʻoe kiliʻi pasia, pea mo e puipui ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki,
And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
Ko e puha ʻoe fuakava, mo hono ongo haʻamo, mo e nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa,
The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
Ko e palepale, mo hono ngaahi nāunau ʻo ia, mo e mā ʻoe ʻao,
The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
Ko e tuʻunga maama maʻa, mo hono ngaahi foʻi maama, mo hono ngaahi ʻaiʻanga maama ke teuʻi, mo hono ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē ʻo ia, mo e lolo ki he maama,
The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
Mo e feilaulauʻanga koula, mo e lolo tākai, mo e meʻa namu kakala, mo e meʻa tautau ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki,
And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
Ko e feilaulauʻanga palasa mo hono meʻa vangavanga palasa, ʻa hono ongo haʻamo, mo hono nāunau kotoa pē, ko e sene mo hono tuʻunga,
The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

Ko e ngaahi puipui tautau ki he lotoʻā, ʻa hono ngaahi pou, mo hono ngaahi tuʻunga, mo e meʻa tautau ki he matapā ʻoe lotoʻā, ʻa hono ngaahi afo, mo hono ngaahi faʻo, pea mo e ngaahi ipu kotoa pē ki he ngāue ʻoe fale tapu, ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai,

The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
Ko e ngaahi kofu ngāue ke fai ai ʻae ngāue ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni, mo e ngaahi kofu māʻoniʻoni kia ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki, mo e ngaahi kofu ki hono ngaahi foha, ke ngāue ai ʻi he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki.
The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
Pea naʻe fai ʻae ngāue kotoa pē ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo fakatatau ki he meʻa kotoa pē naʻe fekau ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese.
According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
Pea naʻe vakai ʻe Mōsese ki he ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē, pea vakai, kuo nau fai ia ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova, ʻio, naʻe pehē pe ʻenau fai ia: pea naʻe tāpuaki ʻakinautolu ʻe Mōsese.
And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“ʻI he ʻuluaki ʻaho ʻoe ʻuluaki māhina, te ke fokotuʻu ʻae fale tapu ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
Pea te ke ʻai ki ai ʻae puha ʻoe fuakava, pea ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻae puha ʻae puipui.
And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
Pea te ke ʻomi ki ai ʻae palepale, pea ke ʻai ʻo fakatonutonu ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻoku totonu ke ʻai ki ai; pea ke ʻomi ki ai ʻae tuʻunga maama, ʻo tutu ʻae ngaahi maama ʻo ia.
And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
Pea te ke tuku ʻae feilaulauʻanga koula ki he meʻa namu kakala, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe puha ʻoe fuakava, pea ʻai ʻae puipui tautau ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
Pea te ke fokotuʻu ʻae feilaulauʻanga ʻoe feilaulau tutu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe matapā ʻoe fale tapu ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
Pea te ke fokotuʻu ʻae sene ʻi he vahaʻa ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, mo e feilaulauʻanga, pea ke ʻai ki ai ʻae vai.
And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
Pea te ke fokotuʻu hono lotoʻā ʻo takatakai ia, pea tautau hake hono puipui ʻi he matapā ʻoe lotoʻā.
And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
“Pea te ke ʻave ʻae lolo tākai, ʻo tākai ʻaki ʻae fale fehikitaki, mo e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ʻi ai, mo ke fakatapui ia, mo hono ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē ʻo ia: pea ʻe māʻoniʻoni ia.
And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
Pea te ke tākai ʻae feilaulauʻanga ʻoe feilaulau tutu, mo hono ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē, ʻo fakatapui ʻae feilaulauʻanga: pea ʻe hoko ia ko e feilaulauʻanga fungani māʻoniʻoni.
And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
Pea te ke tākai ʻae sene mo hono tuʻunga, ʻo fakatapui ia.
And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
“Pea te ke ʻomi ʻa ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻo kaukauʻi ʻakinautolu ʻaki ʻae vai.
And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
Pea te ke ʻai kia ʻElone ʻae ngaahi kofu māʻoniʻoni, pea tākai ia, ʻo fakatapui ia; koeʻuhi ke ne ngāue kiate au ʻi he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki.
And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
Pea te ke ʻomi hono ngaahi foha, ʻo fakakofuʻaki ʻakinautolu ʻae ngaahi kofutuʻa.
And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

Pea te ke tākai ʻakinautolu ʻo hangē ko hoʻo tākai ʻenau tamai, koeʻuhi ke nau ngāue kiate au ʻi he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki: he ko honau tākai ia ki he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki moʻoni ʻo taʻengata ʻi honau toʻutangata kotoa pē tuku fakaholo.”

And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
Pea naʻe fai ia ʻe Mōsese: ʻo hangē ko e meʻa kotoa pē naʻe fekau ʻe Sihova kiate ia, naʻe pehē ʻene fai.
Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
Pea ʻi he ʻuluaki māhina ʻi hono ua ʻoe taʻu, ʻi he ʻuluaki ʻaho ʻoe māhina, naʻe hoko ʻo pehē, naʻe fokotuʻu hake ʻae fale fehikitaki.
And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

Pea naʻe fokotuʻu hake ʻe Mōsese ʻae fale fehikitaki, ʻo ne fakamaʻu hono ngaahi tuʻunga, pea naʻe fokotuʻu hake ʻa hono ngaahi laupapa, pea ʻai ki ai hono ngaahi ʻakau fakamaʻu, pea naʻe fokotuʻu hono ngaahi pou.
And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
Pea naʻa ne folahi atu ʻae fakapulonga ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he fale fehikitaki, pea naʻe ʻai hono fakapulonga ʻe taha ki ai ʻi ʻolunga ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne ʻave ʻae fuakava ʻo ne ʻai ia ki he puha, pea naʻe ʻai ʻae ongo ʻakau haʻamo ki he puha, pea naʻe hili ʻae nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa ki ʻolunga ʻi he puha.
And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
Pea naʻa ne ʻomi ʻae puha ki loto ʻi he fale fehikitaki, pea naʻe fokotuʻu ai ʻae puipui ʻufiʻufi, pea naʻe ʻufiʻufi ai ʻae puha ʻoe fuakava ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne tuku ʻae palepale ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ki he potu tokelau ʻoe fale fehikitaki, ʻituʻa ʻi he puipui.
And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
Pea naʻa ne tuku lelei ʻi ai ʻae mā, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne ʻai ʻae tuʻunga maama ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻo hanga tonu atu ki he palepale, ʻi he potu tonga ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
Pea naʻa ne tutu ʻae ngaahi maama ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne ʻai ʻae feilaulauʻanga koula ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai ʻi he ʻao ʻoe puipui:
And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
Pea naʻa ne tutu ʻae meʻa namu kakala ʻi hono funga ʻo ia; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne tautau hake ʻae puipui ʻi he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

Pea naʻa ne fokotuʻu ʻae feilaulauʻanga ʻoe meʻa tutu ʻo ofi ki he matapā ʻoe fale tapu ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻo ne ʻatu ʻi ai ʻae feilaulau tutu, mo e feilaulau meʻakai; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne fokotuʻu ʻae sene ʻi he vahaʻa ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai mo e feilaulauʻanga, pea naʻe ai ki ʻai ʻae vai, ke kaukau ʻaki.
And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
Pea ko Mōsese mo ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha naʻa nau fanofano honau nima, mo kaukauʻi honau vaʻe ʻi ai:
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
‌ʻI heʻenau hū ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, pea ʻi heʻenau haʻu ʻo ofi ki he feilaulauʻanga, naʻa nau kaukau; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻa ne fokotuʻu ʻae lotoʻā ʻo fakatakamilo ki he fale fehikitaki, mo e feilaulauʻanga, ʻo fokotuʻu hake ʻae puipui ki he matapā ʻoe lotoʻā. Pea naʻe fakaʻosi pehē ʻe Mōsese ʻae ngāue.
And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
Pea hili ia naʻe ʻufiʻufi leva ʻe he ʻao ʻae fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, pea naʻe fakafonu ʻe he nāunau ʻo Sihova ʻae fale fehikitaki.
Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Pea naʻe ʻikai mafai ʻe Mōsese ke hū ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ko e meʻa ʻi he nofomaʻu ki ai ʻae ʻao, pea naʻe fakafonu ʻe he nāunau ʻo Sihova ʻae fale fehikitaki.
And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Pea ka toʻo hake ʻae ʻao mei heʻene fakamalumalu ʻae fale fehikitaki, naʻe fononga ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi honau ngaahi fononga kotoa pē:
And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
Pea kapau naʻe ʻikai toʻo hake ʻae ʻao, pea naʻe ʻikai te nau fononga, kaeʻoua ke hoko ʻae ʻaho kuo toʻo hake ai ia.
But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
He naʻe fakamalumalu ʻae fale fehikitaki ʻe he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻi he ʻaho, pea naʻe ʻi ai ʻae afi ʻi he poʻuli, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fale kotoa pē ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻi honau ngaahi fononga kotoa pē.
For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
